newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher on money demand.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher on money demand.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates reversed a recent downtrend to finish higher on Tuesday due to rising demand for liquidity before the Chinese Lunar New Year on February 7, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.350 percent against Monday's 5.201 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.10-5.35 percent against 5.10. Dealers expected the rates to continue rising and eventually test the 5.5-percent limit before the new year.
The bond market did not see transaction in the afternoon. The 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1475 and the 15-year construction bond yield was at 6.2750 after morning trade.
